newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: National Bank cuts NZ floating, fixed home rates.
newsitem.headline: National Bank cuts NZ floating, fixed home rates.

text.p: National Bank of New Zealand Ltd said on Thursday it was cutting its floating home lending rate to 10.75 percent from 11.5 percent.

The bank also cut its fixed rates. The one-year rate was trimmed to 9.95 percent from 10.50 percent, the two-year to 9.75 percent from 9.90 percent and the three-year to 9.25 percent from 9.90 percent.
The floating rates are effective from November 4 for new customers and December 13 for existing customers. The fixed rates are effective immediately.
